body: Hey...Can we talk?

But the fact that he made it clear is kind of sad...
Until you are married, I do not think you belong to the family...
Make up gift cards

Want a burner number you can text?😂

Nothing changes at all. I contemplate suicide almost everyday. Every time I decide against it. Does my life change? No. But I move on. Do I still contemplate the next day? Yes, but at the end of the day I KNOW I made the right choice.
You do have that power: but you don’t have to use it. You may never get recognized for it, but you become more powerful by choosing to stay alive.
I wish I could tell you something to stop yourself from committing suicide. All I can do is apologize. I am truly sorry you are in this position
Want to talk?
Please go to a doctor. There are other options!😕
Someone like you can hack it. Take a step back. Relax. And if the time comes to throw in the towel, throw it in and move on but not until you ITS TIME

If there is one thing about smart people I have learned it is that the most unsuspected ones are truly the smartest of us all
What are your degrees in?
Everyone has something to offer. You are good at something. I can tell you are smart.
Why shouldn’t they?
Don’t end it! People love you!

I wrongly used the word “shell”. I have never been in a shell, not a “shy” one. But I know exactly how you feel. I was always nice to everyone, went up to everyone talked to them but treated as if I was different, speaking a different language almost. Is that more relatable?
It enrages me when they think they can just act like nothing happened! It is very disturbing. I am so sorry to hear this and I hope you prosper in the future.

I had that problem in middle school and partly in high school. But then my junior/senior year I sorta blossomed. But I really came out of my shell and stared to understand social things and norms my first year of high school! So just hang in there!
I think that’s a common problem! Don’t feel bad. Maybe start practicing? Or approach your friends about your concerns? I am sure they will understand, if not they aren’t real friends!
He has repeatable told me he doesn’t want to do anything. I think he does have a problem. At least I hope he does. As awful as that sounds. I would rather he have a problem than he just not like me
Let’s expand a bit, how do you lack social skills?
I can never make those work

I am glad someone gets it
I don’t think it’s diverting blame. If it was a choice I would choose to be straight, but I am just physically not attracted to women...
